teaser: A level, set down on a sawhorse, settles before you even glance at the bubble. You are a 4, an ISTP, and that is the shape of this reading: a life path built for steady, repeatable progress, crossed with a temperament that only believes what its own hands have proven. The 4 wants a structure that holds for years. The ISTP wants to take the structure apart first, just to see why it holds. Between the two, you get something sturdier than most structures manage, and quieter about it than most readings of the 4.
